additional_info.subject: ID0460704-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/SD 314015297001]CU not connected CRM:03098000188
additional_info.body:
Hello Filomena, good morning. I hope you are doing well today.
I checked the charger remotely and it showed me an error "SIM Failure". It seems that after the reboot it's working again but it might happen again.
My suggestion is to keep this ticket open until Friday and if it reoccurs, we will send the Field Service team for troubleshoot and solution.
If it doesn't happen again, then we will close the ticket.
Please let me know if you find the charger offline again.
Thank you and have a nice week ahead!
Best regards,
Francisco
